description: This file is a shell script library that provides functions to generate JUnit XML reports for test scripts, intended to format output in a way compatible with CI systems and test suites. It offers functions to start tests, finalize test cases, and output XML data, with specific references to test output directories and external utilities.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML file for a test script, creating necessary directories and setting up XML root elements.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Marks the start of a test case, recording the start time.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes a test case, recording the result (pass, failure, skip, etc.), and writes the corresponding XML element.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the XML report, updating total test suite time and closing XML tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Outputs XML content to the designated test report file, optionally truncating existing content.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes input strings into XML-safe attribute format using external encoding utility.
